title: Relay mailbox page read returns misleading home-unavailable 409 despite a successful listing
outcome: A relay mailbox page read that lacks its saved association reports the actual local or remote home/peer state and recovery limits. The reported historical list-then-read failure is diagnosed without assuming a same-pair exact-message read succeeded.
acceptance: A source-cited diagnosis explains why termal_read_mailbox on a relay mailbox homed on a remote runner returns 409 'original native mailbox home is unavailable' while termal_send_to_session, termal_read_mailbox_message and termal_list_mailboxes for the same pairs succeed, and names whether the cause is the federation channel or authority state of the caller, the home-host availability projection, or a defect
If the remote home is reachable, the page read succeeds; if it is not, the refusal names the actual cause and states whether it self-clears, consistently with read_mailbox_message
A deterministic test covers a relay-mailbox page read with an available and with an unavailable remote home
